  <p style="margin-bottom:0.4rem;">In edge-sharing \(d^5\) transition-metal compounds with a \(t_{2g}^5\) (\(J_{\text{eff}} = 1/2\)) configuration such as \(\alpha\text{-RuCl}_3\), virtual electron hopping across ligand bridges dresses magnetic exchange with local charge redistribution \(\delta n_l\) and orbital quadrupole moments \(Q_{\alpha\beta}\) around \(\mathbb{Z}_2\) vortices.</p>
